rows.grounds: ablative singular masculine of bhavapāśa, from the bond of worldly existence
nominative singular masculine participle vinirmukta, freed from
genitive singular of the first-person pronoun, of me
nominative singular masculine adjective tulya, equal to
nominative singular masculine noun saṃśaya, doubt

items.question: What certain status does one attain after being freed from the bond of worldly existence?
premises: freedom from worldly bond precedes equality
the speaker declares equality with the freed one
no doubt remains about this status
items.inference: one freed from worldly bonds is certainly equal to the speaker
uncertainties: the exact referent of mama is not specified in this verse
the scope of bhavapāśa is not further defined here
items.plain_english: Freed from the bond of worldly existence, he is equal to me; there is no doubt.
